chunks: From him, from Sawwar, from Abu Sa'id al-Mukari, from Abd al-Malik ibn Amr, who said:

I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): 'I buy one hundred rawiyyah of oil, then I set aside one or two rawiyyahs, weigh them, and then take the rest according to that proportion.' He said, 'There is no harm in it.'

key_terms.رَاوِيَةٍ: A unit of measurement for oil (rawiyyah)
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: There is no harm / It is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to buy oil in bulk by weighing a sample first?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* illustrates the practical application of avoiding *gharar* (uncertainty) in commercial transactions by validating the method of sampling. Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) permits using a weighed sample to estimate the quality or quantity of the remaining bulk, ensuring fairness and transparency in trade. This ruling underscores the Shia scholarly emphasis on precision and equity in market dealings to prevent disputes.
